h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karawal Nagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karawal Nagar

items.pText: Karawal Nagar is a densely built part of north-east Delhi, close to the Yamuna and the Uttar Pradesh border. Open space is scarce, so the few parks and school grounds in the area carry a lot of children every evening. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to Delhi by road.

In a small, busy park, the question to ask of each piece is how many children it can hold at once. A single swing serves one child at a time, while a four-seat see-saw or a four-seater merry-go-round keeps a whole group busy. We help residents' welfare associations and schools choose equipment by that measure, so queues stay short and quarrels fewer. Delhi's hot summers and smoggy winters also call for materials that are easy to wash clean.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing equipment for a crowded neighbourhood park

c: Look for pieces that several children use together: a multi-seat see-saw, a merry-go-round with fixed seats, a double swing or a play station with more than one slide. Avoid many single-child pieces scattered around, which use up ground and create queues. Keep the busiest pieces near the centre of the park, where adults can see them from the benches. Lay rubber flooring under every piece, since bare ground in a crowded park soon wears into dust or mud.

items.q: Which playground equipment holds the most children in a small park?
items.a: Multi-seat see-saws, merry-go-rounds and play stations with more than one slide. They keep a group of children busy on a modest footprint, which a row of single swings cannot do.

items.q: Can a residents' welfare association order directly?
items.a: Yes. Share the park's measurements, photos and the age group of the children. We send a layout drawing and quote that your association can approve before we start manufacturing.

items.q: Do you deliver to north-east Delhi?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Karawal Nagar and the rest of Delhi by road, and install it through our own team or a dealer in North India.
